definitions: To draw liquid into the mouth by the action of the lips and tongue.
To hold something in the mouth and lick or draw on it.
To be very bad, unpleasant, or of poor quality (informal).
To draw in or absorb something.
To exploit or take advantage of someone or something.
examples: The baby began to suck its thumb.
He sucked on the sweet until it dissolved.
The pump sucks water from the well.
They tried to suck him into their scheme.
